title: The Umbrella by the Cafe Door
summaryZh: 一場大雨讓 Maya 看見鄰居借傘的需要；當三把藍傘遲遲沒有回來時，一張感謝字條讓她和林女士決定把善意變成共享計畫。

sentences.text: On Monday morning, Maya left home under a dark sky and hurried toward the bus stop near Ms. Lin's cafe.
sentences.zh: 星期一早上，Maya 在陰暗的天空下離開家，匆匆走向林女士咖啡店附近的公車站。

sentences.text: She carried a small umbrella, but cold rain splashed her shoes and books before she reached the corner.
sentences.zh: 她帶著一把小傘，但還沒走到街角，冰冷的雨水就濺濕了她的鞋子和書本。

sentences.text: Under the bus shelter, an older man named Mr. Chen was holding a paper bag over his head.
sentences.zh: 公車亭下，一位名叫陳先生的長者正把紙袋頂在頭上擋雨。

sentences.text: Strong wind pushed rain under the shelter, and he could not cross the wide puddle when his bus arrived.
sentences.zh: 強風吹得雨水灌進公車亭；公車抵達時，他無法跨過前方那一大片積水。

sentences.text: Maya offered him her umbrella, but her college class started across town in twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: Maya 想把自己的傘借給他，但她在城鎮另一頭的大學課程二十分鐘後就要開始。

sentences.text: Before she could decide, Ms. Lin ran out of the cafe with a bright blue umbrella.
sentences.zh: 她還沒做出決定，林女士就拿著一把亮藍色的傘從咖啡店跑了出來。

sentences.text: She helped Mr. Chen onto the bus and asked him to return the umbrella whenever he could.
sentences.zh: 她協助陳先生上公車，並請他方便時再把傘送回來。

sentences.text: Back inside, Maya noticed two more blue umbrellas standing in a tall basket beside the cafe door.
sentences.zh: 回到店內後，Maya 注意到咖啡店門邊的高籃子裡還立著兩把藍傘。

sentences.text: Ms. Lin explained that customers often forgot umbrellas, so she had saved several clean ones for rainy days.
sentences.zh: 林女士解釋，客人常把傘忘在店裡，因此她留了幾把乾淨的傘供雨天使用。

sentences.text: She wanted neighbors to borrow them during sudden rain instead of buying cheap umbrellas they did not need.
sentences.zh: 她希望鄰居遇到突如其來的雨時可以借用，而不必購買其實不需要的便宜雨傘。

sentences.text: Maya liked the idea and made a simple sign with thick black letters on a piece of cardboard.
sentences.zh: Maya 很喜歡這個點子，便在一塊紙板上用粗黑字做了一張簡單的告示。

sentences.text: It said, "Take a blue umbrella today, and bring it back tomorrow."
sentences.zh: 上面寫著：「今天帶走一把藍傘，明天再把它帶回來。」

sentences.text: By lunchtime, a delivery worker borrowed one umbrella, and a tired mother took the other.
sentences.zh: 到了午餐時間，一名外送員借走一把傘，一位疲憊的母親也拿走了另一把。

sentences.text: Ms. Lin smiled because the empty basket showed that her umbrellas were useful to people caught outside.
sentences.zh: 林女士笑了，因為空籃子證明了她的雨傘真的幫到了在外遇雨的人。

sentences.text: Maya returned after class and found the rain had stopped and the evening sun was shining.
sentences.zh: Maya 下課後回來，發現雨已經停了，傍晚的陽光也露了出來。

sentences.text: She expected to see at least one blue umbrella by the door, but the basket was still empty.
sentences.zh: 她原以為門邊至少會有一把藍傘，但籃子仍然空空的。

sentences.text: Ms. Lin said good plans sometimes needed patience, although Maya could see worry on her face.
sentences.zh: 林女士說，好計畫有時需要耐心，不過 Maya 看得出她臉上的擔憂。

sentences.text: At seven, they closed the kitchen, cleaned the last table, and checked the basket again.
sentences.zh: 七點時，她們關閉廚房、清理最後一張桌子，接著再次查看籃子。

sentences.text: None of the three umbrellas had returned, and Ms. Lin quietly folded the cardboard sign.
sentences.zh: 三把傘一把也沒有回來，林女士默默把紙板告示折了起來。

sentences.text: After only one day, she wondered if people understood that borrowing was different from keeping.
sentences.zh: 才過了一天，她便開始懷疑大家是否明白借用和占為己有並不相同。

sentences.text: Maya began planning labels and a list of names, but Ms. Lin did not want the project to feel strict.
sentences.zh: Maya 開始構想標籤和借用名單，但林女士不希望這個計畫讓人感到規定森嚴。

sentences.text: Just then, the front door opened, and Mr. Chen stepped in with the first blue umbrella.
sentences.zh: 就在這時，前門打開了，陳先生帶著第一把藍傘走了進來。

sentences.text: A dry thank-you note was tied around its handle with a piece of white string.
sentences.zh: 傘柄上用一條白繩綁著一張乾燥的感謝字條。

sentences.text: He said the umbrella had protected both him and his medicine during the wet trip home.
sentences.zh: 他說，在濕答答的回家路上，這把傘保護了他，也保護了他的藥。

sentences.text: Mr. Chen also offered an old umbrella from his closet for the basket.
sentences.zh: 陳先生還願意從自家衣櫃拿出一把舊傘放進籃子。

sentences.text: His return did not fill the basket, but it changed the feeling in the room.
sentences.zh: 他歸還的傘沒有填滿籃子，卻改變了店裡的氣氛。

sentences.text: Maya suggested giving every umbrella a blue ribbon and adding one clear return message.
sentences.zh: Maya 建議在每把傘上繫一條藍絲帶，並加上一句清楚的歸還提醒。

sentences.text: Ms. Lin agreed, as long as anyone could borrow without money, an app, or a membership card.
sentences.zh: 林女士答應了，條件是任何人都能借用，不必付錢、不必使用應用程式，也不必持有會員卡。

sentences.text: They named it the Blue Umbrella Plan and invited the neighborhood to add more umbrellas.
sentences.zh: 她們將它命名為「藍傘共享計畫」，並邀請鄰居提供更多雨傘。

sentences.text: When Maya left, the basket held two umbrellas and a new sign about sharing, trust, and tomorrow.
sentences.zh: Maya 離開時，籃子裡已有兩把傘，還有一張談著分享、信任與明天的新告示。

questions.q: Why did Ms. Lin first carry a blue umbrella outside?
options: To help Mr. Chen reach his bus
To sell it to a delivery worker

questions.q: What worried Maya and Ms. Lin near closing time?
options: None of the umbrellas had returned

questions.q: What was important to Ms. Lin about the new plan?
options: Anyone could borrow without money or an app
